title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives
abstract: arXiv:2610.11803v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mech

translated_title: PRAXIS：基于符号档案的自我改进模型学习动力学
translated_abstract: 自我改进学习系统会自适应地调整数据选择、优化过程和辅助符号组件，从而产生超出标准学习假设范围的非平稳目标。我们提出了PRAXIS，一个共同进化框架，将生成器、学习器和符号档案建模为相互作用的动力学过程。我们证明：KL约束的生成器更新和受控的档案权重移动可以限制单步目标漂移；在亚高斯噪声下，对于具有持续累积效用优势的程序，档案更新会抑制其相对于任何固定比较器的表现；随机梯度下降能够实现平均平稳性保证，其退化程度由累积目标漂移决定。在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理和算法图推理上的实验显示出生成器稳定化、学习器损失下降和档案集中化，与这些理论机制相一致。
tldr: 该论文提出PRAXIS共同进化框架，将生成器、学习器和符号档案建模为相互作用的动力学过程，并从理论上证明了KL约束更新可限制目标漂移、随机梯度下降的平均平稳性退化由累积目标漂移控制，实验验证了这些理论机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PRAXIS, a co-evolutionary framework modeling generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes, theoretically proving that KL-constrained updates bound one-step objective drift and that SGD's average-stationarity degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift, with experiments validating these theoretical mechanisms.
